title: NEW: Iran warns that any country or company that takes money from Iran's frozen assets will have its ships barred from transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
text:
NEW: Iran warns that any country or company that takes money from Iran's frozen assets will have its ships barred from transiting the Strait of Hormuz."

""The US President, following aggressive actions and continuous attempts to destabilize the region, has announced that the damages to vessels harmed during the imposed war against Islamic Iran, due to insecurity created by the US military and violations involving passage through the illegal and insecure route of the southern Strait of Hormuz, will be paid from Iran's frozen assets."

"While warning the criminal US President regarding the consequences of this illegal action, we declare to all companies and countries that welcome Trump's proposal and use Iran's frozen assets under this pretext that, from now on, the Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran will not allow any of their vessels to transit through the Strait of Hormuz.
